column1: # The reasons an element is refused when it is lowered (GVEC_Lower_Reason), in the order of the enum.
# Columns, separated by TAB: constant (after GVEC_LOWER_), name (gvec_lower_reason_string), lifted by (the phase or shape-family id whose work draws it, or 'never'), what is refused, why.
# tools/lower/gen-reasons.py reads this and writes documentation/refusals.md and src/codec/svg/lower/lower_reason_table.h; `make check-test-data` fails if either is stale.

column4: A gradient whose stops cannot be read (a stop color the waist cannot carry); the stop is reported with its own reason.
column5: Gradients are lowered, in sRGB or in linear light.

column4: a basic shape on a `clipPath`'s shape or on a `use` child of one, a group in `objectBoundingBox` units that holds more than shapes, a clip shape's own clip in `objectBoundingBox` units, or a clip whose shapes' own clips make more terms than the waist's union holds.
column5: A `clipPath` of any number of shapes is lowered, as a union clip. A `clip-path` on one of its shapes, or on a `use` child, is the member's inner clips (the clip's region as a union of intersections, a member for each term), nested to the lowering's depth; what is refused is a basic shape on a `clipPath`'s shape, a group in `objectBoundingBox` units that holds a `use`, text or an image, a clip shape's own clip in `objectBoundingBox` units, and a product of unions past the union's member limit. A reference that names nothing is not a refusal: SVG 2 treats the property as if it were not specified.

column4: `mask` naming a mask of another document, or a mask in the units of the bounding box of an element that holds more than shapes and groups of them.
column5: The box of such an element is not measured, and a mask placed by a guess would be drawing the wrong picture.

column4: a `filter` that names another document, or is in the units of the box of an element whose box is not known (a `use` of a `symbol` or nested `svg`, or a group holding one), or whose feImages draw elements through filters nested deeper than the lowering allows. A list of `url()` references and filter functions is lowered as nested groups; a rotated or skewed element is filtered in a picture of its own; an feImage of an element is lowered as a slot of the filter's picture.
column5: Another document is never fetched, a box that is not known cannot place the filter's units, and the nesting is bounded. The other filters are lowered.

column4: A `text` element that cannot be drawn: there are no fonts in the options, no face of them has its characters, or it has what the lowering does not draw (a `font-variant` other than `normal` and `small-caps`).
column5: Text is lowered in stories, through the font library's matching and shaping and the scene's glyph runs; an element that has more than the lowering draws is refused whole, never drawn without it.

They name the paint of a marker's or a `use`'s context. Those in a marker or in a `use`'s referent are lowered, a gradient among them placed in the context element's box; one anywhere else is not, and a gradient taken from an outer context is refused, and a pattern is refused under `pattern`.

column4: A colour the shape waist cannot carry: a space it has no gamut for, or a colour that needs a conversion the waist does not define.
column5: Converting would approximate the colour. The colour is reported where it was read, and the element using it is refused.
Its content is not SVG; this library does not render it.

column4: A `use` of an element of another document, or of a `data:` URI; an `image` or an `feImage` that names a URL with a scheme (`http:`, `https:`, `file:`), a network path, an absolute path, a path that leaves the image root (by `..`, an escape or a link), or any file when the options name no `image_root`.
column5: Nothing is fetched from a network, ever, and nothing outside the directory the caller names is read (the load never reads outside its input).

column4: A `use` that instantiates more elements than `max_reference_expansion` allows.
column5: Reported when the document was loaded; the use is not instantiated.

column4: A limit of the document, the lowering or `shape-scene` was reached: the drawing nests deeper than `max_depth` once references are expanded, a coordinate is past the waist's range, or a store, list or scene limit was met.
column5: The element is refused rather than truncated.

column4: A property of the element has no value that can be used (the style layer reports it where it was read).
column5: The element cannot be drawn without its value.

column4: A `transform` whose percentages are of a bounding box (`transform-box: fill-box` or `stroke-box`) on an element that has a percentage.
column5: The bounding box is computed with the exact primitives.
This library renders none of them.

column4: A `vector-effect` other than `none` and `non-scaling-stroke` on an element that would be stroked.
column5: The other values (`fixed-position`, `non-scaling-size`, `non-rotation`, `screen`) are not part of SVG 2's rendering model for a static document.

column4: A `style` element (of type `text/css`, or of none) whose sheet cannot be applied: it has an `@import`, which is never fetched, or a conditional rule (`@media`, `@supports`, `@container`) for which this library has no evaluator.
column5: The sheet's rules would change elements the lowering draws; drawing without them would be drawing the wrong picture.
